Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

cfb4th 0.2.0

  • First CRAN release.
  • load_4th_pbp() ranks the betting-line providers CFBD now serves (Bovada, then DraftKings, then ESPN Bet), so a game without a Bovada line gets a fixed choice instead of whichever unranked book came first.
  • Model loading now mirrors nfl4th. The expected-points and field-goal models ship with the package (the field-goal model refreshed to the copy on cfbfastR-data), so nothing is downloaded when the package is attached. The two xgboost models (fourth-down conversion and win probability), 17 MB together, are no longer bundled: each is downloaded from the package’s model_archive GitHub release the first time it is needed and cached under tools::R_user_dir("cfb4th", "cache"); the new cfb4th_clear_cache() forces a fresh download. The installed package shrinks from 17 MB to about 2 MB, and a failed download is one informative error instead of a failure inside a model call.
  • get_4th_plays() requests the ESPN game summary over HTTPS.
  • get_4th_plays() errors clearly unless df is one row with game_id, home_team and away_team. Before, an empty input (what cfbfastR::cfbd_game_info() returns when the CFBD API rejects the key) gave a data frame with no columns, so the caller failed later with “Column desc doesn’t exist”.
  • The model cache is kept in a folder named after the package version, and caching a model removes the caches of other versions, so an upgrade never leaves stale models behind. Caching a model now prints where it was saved, and the model download allows at least 300 seconds.
  • The get_4th_plays() example now runs (under \donttest). The load_4th_pbp() example runs only in an interactive session with a CFBD API key set: scoring one season’s ~10,000 fourth downs takes about a minute.
  • load_4th_pbp() works again with ‘cfbfastR’ 3.x, whose play-by-play already has spread and over_under columns: they are replaced by the provider-ranked betting lines instead of being split into .x/.y columns, which made add_4th_probs() fail. A provider with a spread is preferred, the play-by-play’s own line fills in where the chosen provider has none, and provider / formatted_spread describe the line used.
  • load_4th_pbp() no longer fails with “Column provider not found” when the CFBD API returns no betting lines. cfbfastR::cfbd_betting_lines() returns an empty data frame on any API error, a rate limit (HTTP 429) included; load_4th_pbp() now warns and keeps the play-by-play’s own spread and over/under. Lines without a provider column are ranked on spread alone, with a warning and provider set to NA. get_4th_plays() likewise tolerates games with no ESPN betting lines.
  • load_4th_pbp() gives a clear error when a season’s play-by-play is empty, and add_4th_probs() returns NA probabilities (with a warning, for a non-empty input) instead of failing when no play can be scored.
  • The cfb4th_clear_cache() example uses a temporary cache folder, so it no longer deletes the user’s cached models.
  • dplyr (>= 1.0.0) is required, for any_of(). cli is a new import.
  • Removed unused suggested packages (future, gt, rmarkdown, tictoc, tidyselect, tidyverse).

cfb4th 0.1.2

  • Tidy-select and data-masking fixes to reduce notes/warnings/errors for checks
  • Load cfbfastR models in the same way that the package does (from URL)

cfb4th 0.1.1

  • Re-categorized some plays as unknown (i.e., NA) go: Penalties and Timeouts
  • Fixed bug with 4th down plays inside own 10 not simulating failed go for it plays correctly
  • Fixed bug with some plays having negative timeouts remaining, creating strange results
  • Improved timeout detection in get_4th_plays() and renamed some columns to better match cfbfastR
  • Implemented 2-pt conversion handling. The model no longer assumes a touchdown is worth 7 points

cfb4th 0.1.0

  • Release as package
